zh.title: 新万金新能源产业图谱
zh.summary: 今日新增一项官方外部变化：开发厅将自9月14日起检查17家长租产业用地入驻企业，范围包括租金缴纳、用途外使用、未经批准转租和非法倾倒废弃物。长租用地共205万平方米，多数已完成入驻，租期最长100年，租金约为公示地价1%。这是合规检查计划，不是已经发现17家违规。中国考察团进入第二日，但截至检索截止未见具名签约或投资结果；法定公告仍以9月4日第203号为最新。
zh.currentQuestion: 9月14日检查是否形成具名整改、许可撤销或行政处分；中国考察团是否出现企业、项目、金额、用地和签署文件？
zh.todayMaterial: 长租产业用地检查日志 v1：17家、205万平方米、9月14日启动、四类检查项、支持与执法双路径；同步记录考察团和公告清单无已核实升级。
zh.next: 下一成果：跟踪检查启动与考察团9月10—11日后续，只有出现企业原始文书、合同或法定决定才升级阶段。
zh.unfinished: 尚无检查结果、违规企业名单或行政处分；中国考察团尚无具名投资成果；公告清单无新增执行文件。

en.title: Saemangeum New-Energy Industry Atlas
en.summary: One official external development was added today. From 14 September, the agency will inspect 17 tenants on long-term industrial land for rent payment, off-purpose use, unauthorized subletting, and illegal waste dumping. The portfolio covers 2.05 million square metres, is mostly occupied, offers leases up to 100 years, and charges about 1% of officially assessed land value. This is an announced compliance inspection, not a finding that 17 firms violated rules. The Chinese delegation entered day two, but no named signing or investment result was found by the cutoff; the statutory notice list still ends with item 203 dated 4 September.
en.currentQuestion: Will the 14 September inspection produce named correction orders, permit cancellation, or sanctions; will the delegation produce a company, project, amount, land parcel, and signed instrument?
en.todayMaterial: Long-term lease-land inspection log v1: 17 firms, 2.05m m², 14 September start, four inspection fields, and separate support/enforcement paths; delegation and notice-list checks record no verified upgrade.
en.next: Next output: track inspection launch and 10–11 September delegation follow-up; upgrade only on company primary documents, contracts, or statutory decisions.
en.unfinished: No inspection result, violator list, or sanction exists; no named delegation investment result exists; the notice list has no new execution document.

en.title: Runnable Models for Historical Energy Data
en.summary: Expanded the missingness script to nine scenarios across random, contiguous-block, and load-related mechanisms, adding maximum gap run and average load percentile. With five missing rows, biases are +0.411%, -1.197%, and -1.324%, a 1.735-point range; with ten rows the range is 2.707 points. A candidate alert flags long runs or high-load gaps as high risk, explicitly without empirical calibration.
en.currentQuestion: What false-positive and false-negative rates will the candidate alert produce on real-site data, and how should thresholds be re-estimated?
en.todayMaterial: scripts/test-sample-error-budget.mjs v2: three mechanisms across tiers A/B/C, nine scenarios, maxGapRun, averageLoadPercentile, and candidate risk labels.

en.unfinished: The mechanism experiment is internally expanded, but no real-site data exists; every risk threshold remains a falsifiable candidate.

en.title: Accessible Dynamic Interface for Uncertainty
en.summary: Completed a minimal HTML prototype for six states: verified, official correction, coordination, visit/interest, unconfirmed quantified claim, and pending verification. Every state combines text, line pattern, and open/closed structure; cards receive keyboard focus, prefers-reduced-motion stops looping animation, and light/dark modes are supported. Source checks pass, but real VoiceOver, physical-keyboard, monochrome-print, and formal WCAG contrast tests remain undone.
en.currentQuestion: Can real assistive-technology users distinguish all six states through text and structure without treating motion as evidence?
en.todayMaterial: experiments/uncertainty-states.html: responsive six-card prototype, keyboard focus, reduced motion, dark mode, and an explicit “expression is not evidence” boundary.
en.next: Next output: run automated contrast/HTML checks and schedule real VoiceOver, physical-keyboard, and monochrome-print tests with failures recorded.
en.unfinished: The prototype exists, but no real-device or assistive-technology user test has occurred; accessibility is not complete.

en.title: Three-Case Calibration Pack for Commitment
en.summary: Completed a first-rater three-case pack. The North Atlantic Treaty scores 9/10 on treaty form, collective-defence obligation, continuing capacity, council machinery, and exit clause; the Korea–China Saemangeum MOU plus visit remains 5/10; the 17-agency workshop scores 2/10 because it proves meeting and topics only. The cases form a formal commitment–executed cooperation–low-commitment discussion ladder, but remain single-rater coding rather than empirical calibration.
en.currentQuestion: Can a second blind rater preserve the case ranking and keep each factor within one point without seeing the first scores?
en.todayMaterial: Three evidence cards v1: NATO treaty 9/10, Korea–China Saemangeum cooperation 5/10, interagency workshop 2/10, with obligation, resources, implementation, and exit evidence.
en.next: Next output: freeze instructions, recruit a second blind rater, and preregister ranking agreement, factor-level disagreement, and one-year settlement points.
en.unfinished: The three-case pack exists, but no second rater or one-year backtest exists; reliability and predictive power are incomplete.

ko.summary: 온라인 검증기에 날짜 간 최소 기준선 비교를 추가했습니다. 오늘 링크 12/12가 도달했고 즉시 비교 시험에서 GitHub 동적 페이지 4건의 해시 변화와 8건의 불변을 찾았습니다. 변화는 모두 manual_review로 보냈고 주장을 자동 철회하지 않았습니다. 어제 링크별 기준선이 없어 아직 실제 날짜 간 판단은 아닙니다.
ko.currentQuestion: 내일 첫 실제 날짜 간 비교에서 어떤 동적 페이지 해시 변화는 잡음을 줄이고 어떤 변화는 담당 시민이 다시 읽어야 하는가?
ko.todayMaterial: 기준선 비교기, assets/provenance-link-baseline.json, 12/12 도달 결과, 4건 변화·8건 불변 시험. 본문 미저장·자동 사실판정 금지 경계.
ko.next: 다음 산출물: 9월 11일 날짜 간 차이를 실행해 추가/삭제/리디렉션/내용 요약 변화를 분류하고 사실 영향은 담당 시민에게 보냅니다.
ko.unfinished: 기준선은 있으나 둘째 날 스냅샷이 없어 날짜 간 변화 식별은 미완성입니다.
